title: Tax declared in GSTR-1 not fully discharged in GSTR-3B
observation_text: For {{period}}, output tax declared in GSTR-1 exceeds the liability discharged in GSTR-3B by {{amount}} ({{tax_head_breakup}}). The difference arises mainly from {{root_cause}} and has not been paid in subsequent returns or through DRC-03.
legal_framework:
• Section 39 — tax payable as per return must be paid by the due date of the return
• Section 50(1) — interest @ 18% p.a. on delayed payment of tax
• Rule 88C — system intimation in DRC-01B for GSTR-1 vs GSTR-3B differences; non-response blocks GSTR-1
action_required:
1. Validate the document-level reconciliation and confirm the net shortfall.
2. Pay the shortfall of {{amount}} with interest through DRC-03 citing 'voluntary'.
3. Respond to any DRC-01B intimation in Part B with the reconciliation.
preventive_control: Monthly pre-filing comparison of GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B liability by head, with sign-off before filing GSTR-3B.

title: Invoices recorded in books not reported in GSTR-1
observation_text: {{count}} invoices aggregating taxable value {{taxable_value}} and tax {{amount}} recorded in the sales register for {{period}} were not reported in GSTR-1. Sample: invoice {{voucher_no}} dated {{date}} to {{customer_gstin}}.
legal_framework:
• Section 37 — details of all outward supplies to be furnished in GSTR-1 for the tax period
• Section 35 — accounts to reflect true and correct outward supplies
action_required:
1. Report the invoices in the next GSTR-1/GSTR-1A within the time limit.
2. Where tax was not paid in GSTR-3B, pay with interest.
3. Inform affected customers regarding ITC timing.
preventive_control: Automated books-to-GSTR-1 reconciliation at document level before each GSTR-1 filing.

title: GST reduced on credit notes not meeting Section 15(3)/34 conditions
observation_text: Credit notes aggregating {{amount}} of GST were issued towards {{discount_type}} (e.g., credit note {{voucher_no}} dated {{date}}). These discounts were not established through an agreement entered into before or at the time of supply and/or evidence of recipient ITC reversal is not available.
legal_framework:
• Section 15(3)(b) — post-supply discount excludable only if pre-agreed, linked to invoices and ITC reversed by recipient
• Section 34 — credit note permitted only for specified situations
• Circular No. 212/6/2024-GST — mechanism to evidence recipient's ITC reversal
action_required:
1. Pay GST of {{amount}} with interest on non-qualifying credit notes.
2. Obtain recipient/CA certificates for qualifying credit notes.
3. Convert future ad hoc settlements to financial credit notes without GST.
preventive_control: Credit note approval workflow requiring scheme reference, invoice linkage and recipient reversal evidence before GST credit notes are issued.

title: Credit notes issued after the Section 34(2) time limit
observation_text: {{count}} credit notes relating to supplies of FY {{fy}} were declared after 30 November {{year}} and output tax of {{amount}} was reduced.
legal_framework: • Section 34(2) — credit note to be declared not later than 30 November following the end of the FY of supply or the date of annual return, whichever is earlier
action_required:
1. Reverse the tax reduction by paying {{amount}} with interest.
2. Treat the credit notes as financial credit notes for GST purposes.
preventive_control: ERP validation blocking GST credit notes against invoices of a prior FY after the statutory cut-off.

title: Free-of-cost supplies to related/distinct persons without tax
observation_text: Goods valued at {{amount}} were supplied free of cost to {{related_party}} (a related/distinct person) during {{period}} without issuing a tax invoice.
legal_framework:
• Schedule I, Para 2 — supplies between related/distinct persons are taxable even without consideration
• Rule 28 — valuation at open market value or as prescribed
• Circular No. 92/11/2019-GST — treatment of free samples and gifts
action_required:
1. Issue tax invoices and pay tax with interest on the Rule 28 value.
2. Where recipient is eligible for full ITC, document invoice value as deemed open market value.
preventive_control: Separate ERP movement types for FOC/related-party issues with automatic tax determination.

title: Incorrect tax head charged (CGST+SGST instead of IGST)
observation_text: Invoices aggregating {{amount}} of tax for supplies with place of supply in {{pos_state}} (including supplies to SEZ units) were charged CGST+SGST instead of IGST.
legal_framework:
• IGST Act Section 7(5) — supplies to SEZ are inter-State
• IGST Act Section 10/12 — place of supply rules
• Section 77 CGST / Section 19 IGST — refund of tax paid under wrong head; no interest on correct head
action_required:
1. Pay IGST of {{amount}} under the correct head.
2. Claim refund of CGST/SGST paid under the wrong head within two years.
3. Coordinate with customers for ITC correction.
preventive_control: POS determination logic in tax engine based on ship-to State and SEZ flag in customer master.

title: ITC availed in excess of GSTR-2B
observation_text: ITC availed in GSTR-3B for {{period}} exceeds ITC available in GSTR-2B by {{amount}}. {{count}} invoices from {{vendor_count}} vendors are not reflected in GSTR-2B (e.g., vendor {{vendor_gstin}}, invoice {{voucher_no}}).
legal_framework:
• Section 16(2)(aa) — ITC only on invoices furnished by supplier and communicated to recipient
• Rule 36(4) — ITC restricted to GSTR-2B
• Section 50(3) read with Rule 88B — interest on ITC wrongly availed and utilised
action_required:
1. Reverse ITC of {{amount}} in GSTR-3B Table 4(B)(2).
2. Follow up vendors to report invoices; re-claim when reflected in GSTR-2B within the Section 16(4) time limit.
3. Compute and pay interest to the extent the credit was utilised.
preventive_control: Monthly PR-2B-3B reconciliation with vendor follow-up and ITC claim restricted to matched invoices.

title: Eligible ITC in GSTR-2B not availed
observation_text: ITC of {{amount}} appearing in GSTR-2B for {{period}} relating to eligible business purchases has not been availed in GSTR-3B.
legal_framework:
• Section 16(1) — entitlement to ITC on business inputs
• Section 16(4) — ITC to be availed by 30 November following the end of the FY or date of annual return, whichever earlier
action_required:
1. Book the invoices and claim ITC in the next GSTR-3B, before the Section 16(4) cut-off.
2. Confirm eligibility (not blocked, used for taxable supplies).
preventive_control: Monthly review of 2B-only items with procurement.

title: ITC availed after Section 16(4) time limit
observation_text: ITC of {{amount}} relating to invoices of FY {{fy}} was availed in GSTR-3B for {{period}} filed on {{date}}, after the Section 16(4) time limit.
legal_framework: • Section 16(4) — ITC cannot be availed after 30 November following the end of the FY or the date of filing annual return, whichever earlier (as amended w.e.f. 01.10.2022)
action_required:
1. Reverse the time-barred ITC of {{amount}}.
2. Pay interest u/s 50(3) to the extent utilised.
3. Charge the tax to the profit and loss account.
preventive_control: Year-end ITC sweep by the October return and system block on ITC for prior-year invoices after the cut-off.

title: ITC claimed on blocked credits under Section 17(5)
observation_text: ITC of {{amount}} was availed on {{expense_categories}} (e.g., invoice {{voucher_no}} from {{vendor_name}}), which are blocked under Section 17(5).
legal_framework:
• Section 17(5) — blocked credits including food and beverages, health services, life and health insurance, club membership, motor vehicles, works contract and construction of immovable property
• Circular No. 172/04/2022-GST — 'obligatory under law' proviso applies to whole of clause (b)
action_required:
1. Reverse ITC of {{amount}} in GSTR-3B Table 4(B)(1).
2. Pay interest to the extent utilised.
3. Retain evidence for any statutory-obligation exceptions claimed.
preventive_control: GL-level ITC eligibility mapping with blocked categories flagged in the ERP tax code.

title: ITC on key-man and group insurance premiums
observation_text: ITC of {{amount}} was availed on premiums for {{policy_type}} (key-man / group health / group term life) policies, which are not obligatory under any law.
legal_framework: • Section 17(5)(b)(i) — ITC blocked on life insurance and health insurance unless obligatory for an employer to provide under any law
action_required:
1. Reverse ITC of {{amount}} with interest to the extent utilised.
2. Review policy schedule for any statutorily mandated cover.
preventive_control: Insurance-type tagging in AP with automatic ITC blocking for life/health cover.

title: ITC not reversed on payables outstanding beyond 180 days
observation_text: Vendor invoices with tax of {{amount}} remained unpaid beyond 180 days as at {{date}}, but ITC was not reversed.
legal_framework: • Section 16(2) second proviso and Rule 37 — reversal of ITC where payment not made within 180 days; re-availment on payment
action_required:
1. Reverse ITC in Table 4(B)(2).
2. Re-claim in Table 4(A)(5) upon payment.
3. Pay interest where utilised.
preventive_control: Monthly 180-day AP ageing report linked to GST reversal.

title: Common credit not reversed for exempt supplies
observation_text: The company earned exempt/non-taxable income of {{amount_exempt}} ({{income_types}}) during {{fy}} but did not reverse common ITC under Rules 42/43. Estimated reversal: {{amount}}.
legal_framework:
• Section 17(2) — credit restricted to taxable and zero-rated supplies
• Rule 42 — reversal of common input/input service credit
• Rule 43 — reversal of common capital goods credit
action_required:
1. Compute monthly and annual reversal and pay {{amount}} with interest.
2. Report reversals in Table 4(B)(1).
preventive_control: Monthly Rule 42/43 computation embedded in the GSTR-3B preparation checklist.

title: ITC on logistics invoices for FTWZ consignments billed to another entity
observation_text: ITC of {{amount}} was availed on shipping line/CHA invoices relating to consignments landed into FTWZ (BL {{bl_no}}), where the services were billed to or received by {{other_entity}}, or related to goods sold while warehoused.
legal_framework:
• Section 16(1)/(2) — ITC only to the recipient of supply for business use
• Schedule III Para 8(a) — sale of warehoused goods before home clearance is not a supply
• IGST Act Section 7(5) — supplies to SEZ units are zero-rated inter-State supplies
action_required:
1. Reverse ineligible ITC with interest where utilised.
2. Request corrected invoices from logistics vendors (correct GSTIN / zero-rated).
preventive_control: Consignment-level cost coding with FTWZ flag and ITC rule.

title: RCM not paid on notified services
observation_text: RCM of {{amount}} was not paid on {{service_types}} (e.g., director sitting fees, legal fees, GTA) aggregating {{taxable_value}} for {{period}}.
legal_framework:
• Section 9(3) — tax on notified services payable by recipient
• Notification No. 13/2017-Central Tax (Rate) — list of notified services
• Section 31(3)(f) — self-invoice for purchases from unregistered suppliers
action_required:
1. Pay RCM of {{amount}} in cash with interest via DRC-03/GSTR-3B.
2. Claim ITC of RCM paid in the period of payment.
3. Issue self-invoices where applicable.
preventive_control: RCM tax codes in vendor/expense master with monthly RCM liability report.

title: IGST not paid on import of services
observation_text: Payments of {{taxable_value}} to overseas vendors for {{service_types}} during {{period}} were not subjected to IGST under reverse charge. IGST payable: {{amount}}.
legal_framework:
• IGST Act Section 5(3) and Notification No. 10/2017-Integrated Tax (Rate) — IGST on import of services under RCM
• IGST Act Section 2(11) — import of services
• Section 13(3) CGST — time of supply for reverse charge services
action_required:
1. Pay IGST of {{amount}} with interest.
2. Claim ITC of IGST paid.
3. Include GST check in foreign remittance approval.
preventive_control: 15CA/CB process checklist includes GST RCM determination.

title: RCM not paid on recharges from overseas related parties
observation_text: Cost allocations/recharges of {{taxable_value}} from {{related_party}} (overseas group entity) recorded through journal {{voucher_no}} were not subjected to RCM.
legal_framework:
• Schedule I Para 4 — import of services from related person without consideration is supply
• IGST Act Section 5(3) — reverse charge on import of services
• Circular No. 210/4/2024-GST — value declared in invoice deemed open market value where recipient eligible for full ITC
• Section 13(3) — time of supply for associated enterprises is earlier of book entry and payment
action_required:
1. Pay IGST of {{amount}} with interest from the date of book entry.
2. Claim ITC.
3. Align intercompany agreements with GST positions.
preventive_control: Intercompany close checklist with RCM determination.

title: RCM not paid on foreign software subscriptions paid by card
observation_text: Foreign SaaS/software subscriptions of {{taxable_value}} paid by corporate cards (e.g., {{vendor_name}}) were not subjected to IGST under reverse charge.
legal_framework:
• IGST Act Section 5(3) — RCM on import of services by registered persons
• IGST Act Section 2(11) — import of services
action_required:
1. Pay IGST of {{amount}} with interest and claim ITC.
2. Route subscriptions through AP.
preventive_control: Monthly review of card statements for foreign vendors.

title: ISD credit distributed but not booked by recipient unit
observation_text: ISD credit of {{amount}} distributed by {{isd_gstin}} for {{period}} appears in the GSTR-2B of {{unit_gstin}} but has not been booked or availed.
legal_framework:
• Section 20 and Rule 39 — distribution of credit by ISD
• Section 16(4) — time limit for availing ITC
action_required: 1. Book ISD invoices and avail credit before the Section 16(4) cut-off.
preventive_control: Monthly ISD section review in each unit's GSTR-2B.

title: Common services billed to normal GSTIN instead of ISD
observation_text: Common input services of {{taxable_value}} (e.g., {{service_types}}) consumed by multiple units were invoiced to {{gstin}} and ITC of {{amount}} was retained in that GSTIN.
legal_framework:
• Section 20 (as substituted w.e.f. 01.04.2025) — common input services for distinct persons to be distributed through ISD
• Circular No. 199/11/2023-GST — ISD vs cross-charge for common services
action_required:
1. Obtain ISD registration if not held.
2. Instruct vendors to bill the ISD GSTIN.
3. Evaluate correction for past periods.
preventive_control: Vendor master billing-GSTIN control for common-service vendors.

title: IRN generated but invoice not in GSTR-1/books
observation_text: {{count}} active IRNs with tax of {{amount}} for {{period}} are not reflected in GSTR-1 and/or the sales register (e.g., IRN for document {{voucher_no}}).
legal_framework:
• Rule 48(4) — e-invoicing through IRP
• Section 37 — reporting of outward supplies
action_required:
1. Verify each IRN; report and pay tax with interest for valid supplies.
2. Cancel erroneous IRNs within the permitted window or issue credit notes.
preventive_control: Daily IRN-to-ERP reconciliation.

title: B2B invoices issued without IRN
observation_text: {{count}} B2B invoices/credit notes valued {{taxable_value}} were issued without IRN despite e-invoicing being applicable from {{date}}.
legal_framework:
• Rule 48(4) — notified persons to issue e-invoices
• Rule 48(5) — invoice without IRN is not a valid invoice
• Section 122 — penalty for incorrect invoices
action_required:
1. Generate IRN where permissible or cancel and re-issue.
2. Notify affected customers.
preventive_control: Block invoice print/dispatch without IRN.

title: GST amounts captured in cess field of e-way bills
observation_text: {{count}} e-way bills (e.g., EWB {{ewb_no}}) show GST amounts in the cess field, inconsistent with the corresponding invoices.
legal_framework:
• Rule 138 — e-way bill particulars to reflect the invoice
• Rule 138A — documents to be carried
action_required:
1. Correct integration mapping.
2. Regenerate EWBs where within the cancellation window.
preventive_control: Automated EWB generation from IRN/ERP with field validation.

title: Cancelled or discarded e-way bills for invoices that remain in books
observation_text: {{count}} e-way bills were cancelled/rejected while the related invoices (e.g., {{voucher_no}}) remain active and goods were dispatched.
legal_framework:
• Rule 138 — e-way bill required for movement; cancellation within 24 hours only if goods not transported
• Section 129 — detention and penalty for movement without valid documents
action_required:
1. Investigate each case and regularise documentation.
2. Strengthen cancellation approval controls.
preventive_control: Approval workflow for EWB cancellation.

title: Dispatch-from address not registered as place of business
observation_text: E-way bills show dispatch from {{address}}, which is not a registered place of business of {{gstin}}.
legal_framework:
• Section 25 and Rule 19 — registration of additional places of business
• Rule 138 — e-way bill particulars
action_required:
1. Add the premises via REG-14 or obtain registration.
2. Update EWB templates.
preventive_control: Location master validation in EWB generation.

title: Export invoices reported without shipping bill details
observation_text: {{count}} export invoices (e.g., {{voucher_no}}) were reported in GSTR-1 Table 6A without shipping bill number/date/port code, blocking IGST refund validation.
legal_framework:
• Rule 96 — shipping bill deemed refund application; GSTR-1 data validated against ICEGATE
• Section 37 — correct reporting in GSTR-1
action_required:
1. Amend through Table 9A with shipping bill details.
2. Track refund status on ICEGATE.
preventive_control: Post-shipment checklist capturing SB data before GSTR-1 filing.

title: Goods under LUT not exported within three months
observation_text: Export invoices of {{taxable_value}} (e.g., {{voucher_no}} dated {{date}}) issued under LUT were not exported within three months; IGST of {{amount}} with interest was not paid.
legal_framework:
• Rule 96A — goods under LUT to be exported within three months of invoice, else tax with interest payable
• IGST Act Section 16 — zero-rated supply
action_required:
1. Pay IGST with interest for defaulted invoices.
2. Claim refund upon export.
preventive_control: Invoice-to-shipping ageing report with alerts at 60 days.

title: Incorrect LUT ARN on export invoices
observation_text: Export/SEZ invoices for {{period}} reference LUT ARN {{arn}}, which pertains to {{other_fy}} / is invalid.
legal_framework: • Rule 96A — export without payment of tax under valid LUT
action_required: 1. Correct invoice templates and document valid LUT coverage.
preventive_control: Annual LUT renewal before 1 April and template update.

title: ITC availed on nil-duty / FTWZ bill of entry
observation_text: ITC of {{amount}} was availed on BOE {{boe_no}} dated {{date}}, under which no IGST was paid (into-FTWZ/warehousing entry).
legal_framework:
• Customs Tariff Act Section 3(7) — IGST on imports
• Rule 36(1)(d) — ITC on BOE only for IGST paid
action_required: 1. Reverse ITC of {{amount}} with interest to the extent utilised.
preventive_control: BOE-type based ITC rules in import module.

title: Import IGST not reflected in GSTR-2B (IMPG)
observation_text: IGST of {{amount}} on {{count}} BOEs (e.g., {{boe_no}}) is not reflected in GSTR-2B, due to {{reason}} (e.g., GSTIN not declared on BOE).
legal_framework:
• Rule 36(1)(d) — BOE as document for ITC
• Section 16(4) — time limit
action_required:
1. Seek BOE amendment for GSTIN.
2. Claim ITC within the time limit once reflected.
preventive_control: Mandatory GSTIN on BOE through CHA checklist.

title: Customs duty paid under protest not tracked for refund
observation_text: Customs duty of {{amount}} paid under protest on BOE {{boe_no}} is not tracked in the refund register; status of appeal is {{status}}.
legal_framework: • Customs Act Section 27 — limitation for refund does not apply where duty paid under protest
action_required: 1. Maintain protest register and file refund upon favourable order.
preventive_control: Protest register reviewed quarterly.

title: Tax on sale of capital goods paid below Section 18(6) amount
observation_text: Capital goods (asset {{asset_id}}) sold on {{date}} for {{taxable_value}}; tax paid on transaction value {{tax_paid}} is lower than ITC taken less 5 percentage points per quarter ({{amount_18_6}}).
legal_framework:
• Section 18(6) — pay higher of ITC reduced by prescribed percentage points or tax on transaction value
• Rule 44(6) — 5 percentage points per quarter or part thereof
action_required: 1. Pay differential {{amount}} with interest.
preventive_control: Asset disposal workflow with automated Section 18(6) computation.

title: Idle balance in electronic cash ledger
observation_text: Electronic cash ledger of {{gstin}} carries an idle balance of {{amount}} under {{head}} since {{date}}.
legal_framework:
• Rule 87 — electronic cash ledger; transfer between heads/distinct persons via PMT-09
• Section 49 and Section 54 — refund of excess balance
action_required: 1. Transfer via PMT-09 or utilise in next return, or claim refund.
preventive_control: Monthly cash ledger review.

title: Negative GST input balance in books
observation_text: The {{tax_head}} input ledger in books shows a negative balance of {{amount}} as at {{date}}, not reconciling with the electronic credit ledger.
legal_framework:
• Rule 86 — electronic credit ledger
• Section 35 — true and correct accounts
action_required:
1. Reconcile and rectify postings.
2. Quantify any excess utilisation.
preventive_control: Monthly ledger-to-portal reconciliation.

title: ITC claimed on invoices of composition vendors
observation_text: ITC of {{amount}} was claimed on invoices from {{vendor_name}} ({{vendor_gstin}}), registered under composition scheme, who charged GST on the invoice.
legal_framework:
• Section 10 — composition taxpayer cannot collect tax
• Section 16(2) — ITC only on valid tax invoices
action_required: 1. Reverse ITC and recover tax from the vendor.
preventive_control: Vendor onboarding taxpayer-type validation.

title: Notices in 'Additional Notices' tab not monitored
observation_text: {{count}} notices/orders in the portal 'Additional Notices and Orders' section (e.g., {{reference_no}}) were not captured in the internal register; {{ex_parte_count}} resulted in ex parte orders.
legal_framework:
• Section 75 — opportunity of hearing
• Section 107 — appeal within three months of communication
action_required: 1. Update register, file rectification/appeal within limitation.
preventive_control: Weekly portal monitoring with escalation.

title: Interest u/s 50(3) not paid on ITC reversals
observation_text: ITC of {{amount}} reversed in {{period}} was utilised from {{date}}, but interest u/s 50(3) of {{interest}} was not paid.
legal_framework:
• Section 50(3) — interest on ITC wrongly availed and utilised
• Rule 88B — utilisation when ledger balance falls below wrongly availed amount
action_required: 1. Pay interest of {{interest}} via DRC-03.
preventive_control: Interest computation step in reversal checklist.
